name: Hyperreflexia
clinical_meaning: Supports an upper motor neuron process above the reflex arc.
notes: Explicit Phase-3 finding curation; source status is record-specific.
concise_definition: Exaggerated deep-tendon reflexes, often with spread or clonus.
mechanism: Loss of descending corticospinal inhibition increases spinal reflex activity.

important_mimics: Anxiety, hyperthyroidism, stimulant effect
limitations: Acute spinal shock can initially suppress reflexes.

mechanism: Disruption of peripheral sensory, motor, or root reflex arcs prevents the response.
localization_value: Localizes to peripheral nerve, root, anterior horn, or muscle rather than cortex.

name: Pronator drift
clinical_meaning: A sensitive bedside sign of contralateral hemispheric or corticospinal dysfunction.
notes: Explicit Phase-3 finding curation; source status is record-specific.
